part: EFM8BB51F16I-C-QFN20R (U6-U9); same QFN20 package as the G grade (LCSC C6547511)
datasheet: Silicon Labs EFM8BB51 Data Sheet Rev. 1.0 (https://www.silabs.com/documents/public/data-sheets/efm8bb51-datasheet.pdf; local scratchpad/dl/ds/efm8bb51.pdf): s7.2 Table 7.2 / Fig 7.2 PCB land pattern p56 (C1=C2=3.10, C3=C4=2.50, E=0.50, X1=0.30, Y1=0.90, X2=Y2=0.25-0.35 -> 0.30 nominal, X3=Y3=1.80; note 4 NSMD, note 7 perimeter stencil 1:1, note 8 centre pad 2x2 openings 0.75 on 0.95 pitch); body Table 7.1 p54-55 (D=E=3.00 BSC, A 0.80 max); pinout Fig 6.1 p44 (top view, corner pins 1/6/11/16), Table 6.1 p44-46 (centre pad = GND)
derivation: IPC-7351 least density (L) variant of lib:QFN-20_3x3mm_P0.5mm_EFM8BB51 (D109, D101 full land set): toe 1.61 (D 3.00 BSC, aaa 0.15 -> 1.575 max + 0.035), heel 1.10 kept (= D/2-Lnom), width 0.25 = b nom, EP/paste unchanged; the 4 through-hole EP via pads of the original are removed (D107 + orchestrator 18:55: microvias in the EP and buried vias under the body are placed on the board). Rule: outer land edge = max(terminal end nominal + 0.05, terminal end at max package tolerance + 0.03), capped at nominal + 0.15; heel kept unless it ran past D/2 - Lmax; side = max(IPC-7351B L X, b nominal), never wider than the original; courtyard = max(body, lands) + 0.10. Origin, pad numbers, EP/paste/mask and 3D model unchanged. Base derivation: Lands = Table 7.2 nominal (no rounding). Original EP vias (4 x through 0.35/0.20 PTH pads numbered 21, D6) not carried into _L (D107). All 20 pins kept: unused P0.0/P0.6/P0.7/P1.6 are GPIOs (Table 6.1), not NC, and trimming does not change the courtyard.
